note: A1+ Unit 5 Lesson 5.15, built on 2026-11-20 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number. The user asked on 2026-11-20 to "work on a1+ Unit 5 same all deal as before none stop all approved": A1+ 5.Y follows A1 5.Y with one step each, straight to Preview in batches, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview. The review uses twelve new Flash photos of new people: a girl with three eggs, a boy with a little soup, a man offering an older woman coffee, two friends who both love cake, a tired man who wants to go to bed, a father washing the plates after dinner, a sack of potatoes at $6, a woman ordering soup, a white cup at $5 by a red cup at $15, a jacket at $57, a sandwich with egg and cheese and an older couple passing the salt.

lesson.title: 5.15 Review: at the market and the table
lesson.unit_outcome: Say how much and how many, offer and order food and drinks politely, agree about likes, say what you want and need to do, talk about meals, prices and what is in your food, compare prices, use numbers to ninety-nine and ask for things at the table.
lesson.lesson_title: Review: at the market and the table
lesson.sub_lesson_title: Review: at the market and the table
lesson.goal: Review every A1+ Unit 5 step with new people: a lot of, a few and a little, Would you like …?, How much and How many, So do I, want to and need to, before and after meals, How much are …?, I'd like, Anything else?, cheaper and more expensive, numbers to ninety-nine, What's in it? and Can you pass …?, with no new language.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 5.15 Unit 5 Review: A1 reviews food, quantities, meals, agreement, wants and needs and purchases with fresh scenes; A1+ 5.15 reviews every A1+ Unit 5 step on thirteen new photos of new people, with no new language. Each fact is offered as a picture item, whose wrong pictures are the other photos, and as a sentence item, whose wrong options change only the reviewed form. Nobody in it speaks in the first person except in fixed replies, because the cast's voices belong to the cast: the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say every Unit 5 form at a natural pace, with a lot of, a little, would you and can you joined; do not require native-like speed.
